engine: Webflow IX2 (not GSAP, not Framer Motion, no IntersectionObserver in site code)
note: The complete motion inventory for the whole marketing site. It is genuinely tiny. Several states deliberately have NO transition and must stay that way.

scrollReveal.slideInBottom.trigger: scroll into view, offset 20% of viewport height
scrollReveal.slideInBottom.doesNotRunOn: /parents and /sitters carry the same class but no data-w-id and no inline opacity:0 — do NOT add a reveal there

mobileNav.open.perProperty: burger lines 300ms at delay 0 for translateY, 300ms at delay 200 for rotateZ; card opacity+translateY 400ms at delay 200; overlay opacity 300ms at delay 0

mobileNav.close.asymmetry: rotateZ back to 0 at delay 0; everything else at delay 200

tabs.desktopSwitch.card: animation slideInFromBottom 500ms ease, translateY(20%)->0, replays on every switch

appliesTo: .button-primary (declares no transition — hover and :active are instant)
blog post cards (no hover state and no transition)

notPresent.videoAutoplay: none — 0 <video> elements site-wide; /trust-safety is a click-to-play facade
notPresent.swiperSlides: 1 live .swiper on /parents and /sitters but 0 .swiper-slide (empty CMS collection); no autoplay, no loop
notPresent.prefersReducedMotion: NO @media (prefers-reduced-motion) block exists in the original stylesheet or inline embed. Generated instances must still declare reducedMotionFallback; implementing it is an additive improvement over the original, documented as such.
